results.name: Small Cafe
results.description:
Small modern cafe which I made for a university assignment. All the textures are baked!

Despite its compact size, the cafe is fully functional, with a counter at the entrance where your people can order their coffee or food. There's a small seating area with tables and chairs, making it a great place for your players to take a break and refuel. The space is well-lit with large windows, showcasing vibrant textures.

results.name: Cafe Chair
results.description:
A realistic 3D model of a classic wooden café chair featuring a sturdy timber frame and a padded leather seat. The design combines simplicity and functionality, making it suitable for restaurant, café, interior visualisation, and game environment projects.

The model includes detailed wood grain and leather textures, with proportions and construction inspired by modern café furniture. It is ideal as an environment prop for architectural renders, virtual scenes, or interactive experiences.

results.name: Metal Cafe Chair
results.description:
Originally made famous in the quaint bistros of France, these midcentury replicas of vintage style café seating will offer a dose of nostalgia.  Featuring a curved back with vertical slat and drain holes in the seat.  A cross brace underneath the seat adds extra stability while the vibrant color will rev up any setting. 

Dimensions:  18" x 19" x 34" H
Seat Height:  17"
